'''Matarmeno Krahnn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who had served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the decades before the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the fall of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] born on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Matarmeno Krahnn was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], obtaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] before the fall of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Declaration of a New Order]] that marked the end of the Jedi Order. Retreating into exile, Krahnn returned to his homeworld and took up residence in the city of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]]. During the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Krahnn was actively seeking out a Force-user who could retrieve the [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] of Jedi who had lived during the reign of the Empire.<ref name="AED" />
